svg.title: Randomized trials: cancer on GLP-1 drugs vs comparison
svg.desc: Randomized trials: cancer on GLP-1 drugs vs comparison. Breast cancer (48 trials, 2026): OR 0.95 (95% interval 0.6 to 1.49). Pancreatic cancer (48 trials, 2026): OR 0.84 (95% interval 0.53 to 1.35). Kidney cancer (48 trials, 2026): OR 1.12 (95% interval 0.78 to 1.6). Thyroid cancer (48 trials, 2026): OR 1.37 (95% interval 0.82 to 2.31). Thyroid cancer (15 trials, 2026): OR 1.52 (95% interval 0.86 to 2.68). All cancers (50 trials, 2025): OR 1.05 (95% interval 0.98 to 1.13). Uterine cancer, obesity trials (2025): OR 0.24 (95% interval 0.06 to 0.94). Colorectal cancer (50 trials, 2025): OR 1.27 (95% interval 1.03 to 1.57). Obesity-related cancer, weight drugs (25 trials): RR 1.03 (95% interval 0.78 to 1.37).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
